# apicurio_system_info (Data Source)

Information about the Apicurio Registry the provider is connected to (`GET /system/info`). Useful as a smoke test of the connection and to gate configuration on the server version.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apicurio_system_info" "this" {}

output "registry_version" {
  value = data.apicurio_system_info.this.version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `built_on` (String) Build timestamp of the server (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Server description.
- `id` (String) The registry URL.
- `name` (String) Server name, for example `Apicurio Registry (SQL)`.
- `version` (String) Server version, for example `3.3.4`.
